methodology.control: Fixed70%four-factor equity/30%gold of the98%invested budget, four equity factors equally weighted; monthly rebalancing.
methodology.adaptation: At completed month ends, estimate annualized excess means from the last252daily observations using an exponentially decaying63-session half-life. Shrink each non-BIL mean halfway to the cross-asset non-BIL mean. Estimate the same trailing sample covariance with10%diagonal shrinkage.
methodology.allocation: Maximize estimated mean minus one-half times risk_aversion times covariance variance, less a fixed0.006annualized absolute change penalty from the previous issued target. Constraints: sum98%,each equity-factor fund2.5%-25%,gold0%-50%,BIL0%-88%. No leverage or shorting.
methodology.why_not_dma_replication: This is a constrained causal moment estimator/portfolio optimizer. It is not Bayesian predictive-likelihood DMA and does not claim the cited papers' forecasts or published returns.
methodology.timing: Only completed month-end history; trade next open or one further session at20bp stress. Estimates and previous-target state update strictly in chronological order. No full-sample parameter normalization or random train/test split.
methodology.factor_count: Adaptively combining existing factors is not discovering new economic factors. The weekly discovery program remains separate.
methodology.scope: Actual factor ETF portfolio; no direct-stock historical fundamental coverage is claimed.
methodology.selection_bias: These two fixed methods are proposed after earlier failures. All outcomes and tests count; no subsequent parameter sweep or relabeling of exposed history.
